name: graphiti
purpose: Connect to an existing remote Graphiti service when the packaged local Spec Brain runtime is not selected.
runtime: Python >=3.10; approved existing Graphiti service preferred
capabilities: reviewed ingestion and maintenance only through separately approved agents
setup_steps: Prefer an existing approved Graphiti service pinned to mcp-v1.0.2
Configure its explicit Neo4j backend, model endpoint, embedding model, costs, and data-handling policy outside this repository
Set GRAPHITI_MCP_URL locally and review exposed tools plus service-side project authorization
health_check: MCP initialize, initialized notification, and tools/list only; do not call add, delete, or clear tools
corrective_action: Set GRAPHITI_MCP_URL to the approved project-scoped service, verify tool permissions, and leave mutating tools disabled unless separately authorized.
permissions: Default agents receive retrieval only. Group/project namespace is organization, not authorization. Never bypass Graphiti with unrestricted Neo4j writes.
